title: Gemini月活破10亿：谷歌史上增速最快产品，正式进入与ChatGPT同一量级
title_en: Gemini Hits 1B Monthly Users: Google's Fastest-Growing Product, Entering ChatGPT Orbit
title_break:
Gemini月活突破10亿大关
谷歌AI正式跻身十亿俱乐部
title_break_en:
Gemini Crosses 1B MAU Milestone
Google AI Joins the Billion-User Club
deck: 8月11日谷歌官方宣布Gemini月活跃用户突破10亿，成为谷歌史上增长最快的产品。63%用户通过语音交互，每日生成图片超1.5亿张。AI入口战争从双雄对决进入三方均衡。
deck_en: On August 11, Google officially announced Gemini surpassed 1 billion monthly active users — the company's fastest-growing product ever. 63% of users interact via voice, generating over 150 million images daily. The AI入口 war shifts from two champions to three-way balance.
